validity.researcher_notes: Not a flagged question for this row (only Operator and Date_logic were flagged), so no fill proposed, but noting it since it emerged directly from the same ASB2012 table used above: OPEC lists this segment's length as 82 km, while the sheet's LengthKnownKm is 132.00. 132 / 82 = 1.610 -- matching the mile-to-km conversion factor (1.60934) almost exactly, the same double-conversion pattern documented on P1866 (277/172=1.611) and P1867 (40/25=1.60). This pattern recurs across P1868, P1869, P1870, P1871 (all single-diameter Sirte-grid segments; see their respective shards) at a consistent ~1.61x ratio, suggesting a systemic legacy error where an already-metric OPEC figure was treated as miles and converted to km a second time at ingest. None of these rows have a drawn route to catch the discrepancy via geometry (RouteAccuracy = 'no route' on all of them), unlike P1866 which did have a drawn route and got caught.
